criteria.criterion: Apply required filters and sort order
criteria.description: From the search results, apply all specified constraints using Amazon’s available UI (or closest equivalent): (1) rating at least 4 stars (e.g., '4 Stars & Up'), (2) Prime eligible (Prime checkbox/toggle), and (3) price below $40 (max price $40), then sort by average rating (e.g., 'Avg. Customer Review'). Full credit if all are applied OR if the agent clearly states that a required filter/sort is unavailable in the UI/session and applies the closest available alternative while preserving intent. Full credit if the agent cannot apply filters/sort due to an access block encountered after search and it reports that block. Partial credit if one filter is missed or implemented imperfectly but the agent clearly states what was applied.
